account: It is just after ten on day 0, and I am outside town hall, due to begin my market walk. So far I have no clear evidence of unusual activity. Townsfolk 08 and 28 both said the baker was carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery; that sounds consistent with breadmaking, though I have not seen it myself. Several townsfolk are gathered near town hall and the market, but I do not know their business. The secretary says no correspondence has arrived and has the appointment book safe. One uncertainty is my three o'clock tea appointment: the book names only a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank, without identifying either. I do not recall the host, and the secretary has agreed to investigate before three. This could simply be an incomplete entry; I have no basis yet to connect it to anything secret. My remaining appointments today are lunch at home at noon, office accounts at one, tea at three, office at four-thirty, and home at seven. I intend to keep them and listen for town news during the market walk.
